CheckpointerMain.overview: Main entry point for checkpointer process. Manages checkpoint scheduling, timing, and coordination between background writer and WAL subsystem.

RequestCheckpoint.overview: Interface for backend processes to request a checkpoint. Handles different checkpoint types and coordination with checkpointer process.

CreateCheckPoint.overview: Core checkpoint execution function. Coordinates buffer sync, WAL flushing, and control file updates for complete checkpoint creation.

BufferSync.overview: Synchronizes all dirty buffers to disk during checkpoint. Implements sophisticated scheduling to balance I/O load across tablespaces.

SyncOneBuffer.overview: Synchronizes a single buffer to disk. Central function for both checkpoint and background writer buffer flushing operations.

FlushBuffer.overview: Low-level buffer flushing function. Handles WAL flushing requirements, checksum calculation, and actual disk I/O operations.

BackgroundWriterMain.overview: Main loop for background writer process. Continuously scans buffer pool to write dirty buffers and reduce checkpoint I/O spikes.

BgBufferSync.overview: Background writer buffer synchronization logic. Implements LRU-based scanning with adaptive algorithms for optimal performance.

CreateRestartPoint.overview: Creates restart points during WAL recovery. Similar to checkpoints but optimized for recovery scenarios and standby servers.

CheckPointGuts.overview: Core checkpoint implementation shared between regular checkpoints and restart points. Orchestrates all checkpoint activities.

CheckPointBuffers.overview: Checkpoint-specific buffer management wrapper. Calls BufferSync with appropriate checkpoint flags.

UpdateControlFile.overview: Updates and flushes PostgreSQL control file. Critical for maintaining database consistency and recovery information.

ProcessSyncRequests.overview: Processes accumulated fsync requests during checkpoint. Ensures all dirty data reaches stable storage.

AbsorbSyncRequests.overview: Absorbs pending sync requests from shared memory queue. Prevents queue overflow during checkpoint operations.

CheckpointWriteDelay.overview: Controls checkpoint I/O rate to meet completion targets. Implements adaptive throttling to spread checkpoint load.

LogCheckpointStart.overview: Logs checkpoint start in WAL. Records checkpoint metadata for recovery and monitoring purposes.

LogCheckpointEnd.overview: Logs checkpoint completion in WAL. Marks successful checkpoint completion for recovery processes.

XLogFlush.overview: Ensures WAL records are flushed to disk up to specified LSN, implementing WAL-before-data rule critical for crash consistency.

XLogWrite.overview: Physical WAL write implementation handling segment management, I/O operations, and checkpoint triggering.

update_controlfile.overview: Low-level control file update implementation with atomic write and fsync operations for crash recovery consistency.

XLogInsert.overview: Inserts WAL records into the WAL stream with proper formatting and LSN assignment for checkpoint coordination.

WALInsertLockAcquireExclusive.overview: Acquires exclusive WAL insertion locks to coordinate checkpoint with concurrent WAL writers.

smgrwrite.overview: Storage manager write interface for physical page writes to relation files during buffer flushing.

RemoveOldXlogFiles.overview: Removes or recycles old WAL segment files after checkpoint completion to manage disk space.

KeepLogSeg.overview: Determines which WAL segments must be kept for recovery, replication, and point-in-time recovery.

UpdateMinRecoveryPoint.overview: Updates minimum recovery point for standby servers. Ensures consistent recovery state across checkpoint boundaries.

UpdateCheckPointDistanceEstimate.overview: Updates checkpoint distance estimates for optimization. Helps predict optimal checkpoint scheduling intervals.

IsCheckpointOnSchedule.overview: Determines if checkpoint is proceeding according to schedule. Used for adaptive I/O throttling decisions.

architectural_insights.checkpoint_triggering: Checkpoints can be triggered by time (CheckPointTimeout), WAL volume (max_wal_size), or manual requests. The checkpointer process coordinates all triggers through RequestCheckpoint interface.
architectural_insights.buffer_flushing_strategy: BufferSync implements sophisticated I/O balancing across tablespaces with throttling via CheckpointWriteDelay to spread writes over checkpoint_completion_target timeframe. Uses binary heap for tablespace load balancing.
architectural_insights.wal_coordination: WAL-before-data rule enforced by XLogFlush in FlushBuffer. Checkpoint records bracket the checkpoint operation with REDO and ONLINE/SHUTDOWN records. WALInsertLockAcquireExclusive ensures atomicity.
architectural_insights.background_writer_integration: Background writer proactively cleans buffers to reduce checkpoint I/O load using LRU scanning with adaptive feedback control based on buffer allocation patterns.
architectural_insights.recovery_coordination: Control file updates are atomic and occur after all data flushing via update_controlfile. CreateRestartPoint handles standby server checkpointing with specialized recovery logic.
architectural_insights.io_spreading: Checkpoint I/O is spread across time and tablespaces to minimize system impact, with progress tracking, delay injection via CheckpointWriteDelay, and barrier event processing.
architectural_insights.full_page_writes: Full page writes (FPW) handled transparently during buffer flushing when full_page_writes=on, protecting against torn page writes during crashes.
architectural_insights.segment_recycling: WAL segment cleanup managed by RemoveOldXlogFiles and KeepLogSeg, balancing disk space with recovery/replication requirements.
